witness.branch: Roadway walking adjacent to a sidewalk in an overpass scene.
witness.reason: The overpass layout permits a roadway-side walking route beside the fixed sidewalk.
required_context: Document pedestrian-use purpose, sidewalk extent, roadway boundaries and shoulders.
Establish sidewalk existence, extent, pedestrian-use purpose and relationship to curb or highway lines and adjacent property.
Establish supported sidewalk geometry and an afoot ego route along and upon its adjacent roadway.
Preserve municipal definition applicability and the unresolved state-law sidewalk-obstruction permission and its interaction; invent no distance, duration or directional cutoff.
Retain jurisdictional applicability, supplied-definition uncertainty and unresolved state-law interaction.
Retain roadway and shoulder boundaries and the complete walking trajectory, occupancy, heading, distance and timing.
Specify the overpass relationship without assuming that the sidewalk or ego occupies the deck.
Specify the overpass relationship without treating its presence as proof of sidewalk provision or roadway adjacency.
witness.subject_reason: Pedestrian is available, and the constructed afoot travel matches the walking subject.
